type.quote: The Board shall consist of 10 members appointed by the Governor, as follows: (1) Five of the members of the Board shall be licensed architects ... (2) Three of the members of the Board shall be registered interior designers

interval_years.quote: Certificates or registrations must be renewed on or before the first day of July in each year.

required.quote: When necessary to protect the public health, safety, or welfare, the Board shall require such evidence as it deems necessary to establish the continuing competency of architects and interior designers as a condition of renewal of licenses and registrations.

available.quote: The Board may accept satisfactory evidence of registration, licensure, or certification as an interior designer in another jurisdiction, if the jurisdiction's requirements for registration, licensure, or certification are substantially equivalent to or greater than those required for registration in this State at the date of application.

requirements.value: The other jurisdiction's requirements must be substantially equivalent to or greater than those required for registration in NC at the date of application.
requirements.quote: The Board may accept satisfactory evidence of registration, licensure, or certification as an interior designer in another jurisdiction, if the jurisdiction's requirements for registration, licensure, or certification are substantially equivalent to or greater than those required for registration in this State at the date of application.

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any individual, firm or corporation to practice or offer to practice architecture in this State as defined in this Chapter, or to use the title "Architect" or "Registered Interior Designer" or any form thereof ... unless such person holds a current individual or corporate certificate of admission to practice architecture or registration to practice interior design under the provisions of this Chapter.

credential_type.quote: Registered interior designer. - A person who is duly registered and who is qualified by education, experience, and examination to engage in the practice of interior design as authorized by the Board.

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any individual, firm or corporation to practice or offer to practice architecture in this State as defined in this Chapter, or to use the title "Architect" or "Registered Interior Designer" or any form thereof ... unless such person holds a current individual or corporate certificate of admission to practice architecture or registration to practice interior design under the provisions of this Chapter.

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any individual, firm or corporation ... to use the title "Architect" or "Registered Interior Designer" or any form thereof ... unless such person holds a current individual or corporate certificate of admission to practice architecture or registration to practice interior design under the provisions of this Chapter.

scope_protection.quote: This Chapter does not prevent any person from rendering interior design services, provided the person does not use the title of "registered interior designer" unless registered under this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in professional relationships or in obtaining/maintaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in any professional relationship with clients or other persons; or with reference to obtaining or maintaining license, or with reference to qualifications, experience and past or present service.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or permitting one's professional seal to be used by others, or representing oneself as the author of work not personally prepared or supervised.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or permitting an individual professional seal to be used by or for others, or otherwise representing registrant as the author of drawings or specifications other than those prepared personally by or under direct supervision of registrant.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a professional license or registration that had been suspended or revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using a professional license or registration from the Board that had been suspended or revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct resulting in disciplinary action by a regulatory body of another state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct of the registrant resulting in the imposition of other disciplinary action by a regulatory body of another state for any cause other than failure to pay applicable fees.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrendering or failing to renew a professional license after initiation of an investigation or proceeding.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Surrendered or did not renew a professional license or registration after the initiation of any investigation or proceeding by such body.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, recklessness, or excessive errors or omissions or building failures in professional practice record.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence, recklessness, or excessive errors or omissions or building failures in registrant's record of professional practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical disability or addiction impairing professional skill and care so as to endanger public health, safety, and interest.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical disability or addiction to alcohol or drugs so as to endanger health, safety and interest of the public by impairing skill and care in professional services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged mentally incapable by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The registrant has been adjudged mentally incapable by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice interior design without a current registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice architecture or interior design without a current license or registration from this Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding or abetting others to evade or violate the provisions of this Chapter or health and safety laws.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding or abetting others to evade or violate the provisions of this Chapter, or the health and safety laws of this or other states

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a financial interest or accepting compensation that would reasonably appear to compromise professional judgment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly undertaking any activity or having any significant financial or other interest, or accepting any compensation or reward except from registrant's clients, any of which would reasonably appear to compromise registrant's professional judgment in serving the best interest of clients or public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully violating this Chapter or Board rules, or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or crime of moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully violating this Chapter or any rule or standard of conduct published by the Board, or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or any crime involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely impersonating a practitioner or practicing under an assumed or fictitious name.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsely impersonating a practitioner or former practitioner of a like or different name or practicing under an assumed or fictitious name.

definition_quote.value: The preparation of working drawings and documents relative to interior construction, materials, finishes, space planning, furnishings, fixtures, and equipment as defined in subdivision (5a) of this section. Except as provided herein, interior design services do not include services that constitute the practice of architecture as defined in this Chapter or the practice of engineering as defined in G.S. 89C-3.
definition_quote.quote: The preparation of working drawings and documents relative to interior construction, materials, finishes, space planning, furnishings, fixtures, and equipment as defined in subdivision (5a) of this section. Except as provided herein, interior design services do not include services that constitute the practice of architecture as defined in this Chapter or the practice of engineering as defined in G.S. 89C-3.

(2) The applicant is a licensed architect certified by the Board.

nonstructural_scope_only.quote: The term "interior design" specifically excludes the following: a. The design of or the responsibility for architectural and engineering work, except as explicitly provided for within this Chapter. b. Altering or affecting the structural system of a building.

value: building's live or dead load on the structural system
changes of use to occupancies not already allowed by the current building
life safety plans, including exiting and exit stairs
excluded_building_systems.quote: The term "interior design" specifically excludes the following: ... b. Altering or affecting the structural system of a building. c. Changing the means of access system. d. Changing the building's live or dead load on the structural system. e. Changes of use to occupancies not already allowed by the current building. f. Changes to life safety plans, including exiting and exit stairs.

residential_practice_exempt.quote: This Chapter does not prevent any person from rendering interior design services, provided the person does not use the title of "registered interior designer" unless registered under this Chapter.

interior_decorator_exemption.quote: This Chapter does not apply to persons holding themselves out as "interior decorators" or offering "interior decorating services," and who provide services that are not subject to regulation under applicable building codes, such as selection or assistance in selecting surface materials, window treatments, wall coverings, paint, floor coverings, surface-mounted lighting, or loose furnishings.

permit_submission_authority.quote: A registered interior designer shall possess the authority to sign and seal interior technical submissions covering the scope of the practice of interior design and shall have the authority to submit construction documents where the registered interior designer is the contract holder and Designer of Record to a State or local government entity for the purpose of obtaining requisite permits for an interior construction project.

seal_required.quote: Each registered interior designer shall obtain a seal as prescribed by the Board. A document issued by the registered interior designer and being filed for public record shall bear the signature and seal of the interior designer who prepared or approved the document and the date on which it was sealed.

conflict_of_interest_rules.quote: Knowingly undertaking any activity or having any significant financial or other interest, or accepting any compensation or reward except from registrant's clients, any of which would reasonably appear to compromise registrant's professional judgment in serving the best interest of clients or public.

business_entity_practice_permitted.quote: Any interior design firm desiring to practice interior design in this State shall file a firm application on forms provided by the Board, accompanied by the required application fee. To be eligible for a firm registration, the firm must meet all requirements of the Business Corporation Act.

value: current and emerging bodies of knowledge and skills of the registered interior designer's profession
continuing_education_topical_focus.quote: Such requirements shall be designed solely to improve the professional knowledge and skills of a licensee or a registered interior designer directly related to the current and emerging bodies of knowledge and skills of the licensee's or registered interior designer's profession.
